Autohome INC (ATHM) Holder Origin Asset Management Llp Lowered Its Holding by $5.54 Million as Stock Rose Posted by Richard Conner 08 pm
Origin Asset Management Llp decreased its stake in Autohome Inc (ATHM) by 28.67% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Origin Asset Management Llp sold 72,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 22.95% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 179,100 shares of the edp services company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $13.86M, down from 251,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Origin Asset Management Llp who had been investing in Autohome Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.68B market cap company. The stock decreased 4.34% or $3.74 during the last trading session, reaching $82.43. About 918,580 shares traded. Autohome Inc. (NYSE:ATHM) has risen 50.75% since December 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 50.75% the S&P500.
Origin Asset Management Llp, which manages about $2.70B and $1.53B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Biogen Idec Inc (NASDAQ:BIIB) by 25,500 shares to 62,900 shares, valued at $22.22M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Littlefuse Inc (NASDAQ:LFUS) by 18,200 shares in the quarter, for a total of 72,916 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await Autohome Inc. (NYSE:ATHM) to report earnings on March, 6. They expect $1.11 EPS, up 40.51 % or $0.32 from last year’s $0.79 per share. ATHM’s profit will be $130.32 million for 18.57 P/E if the $1.11 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.90 actual EPS reported by Autohome Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 23.33 % EPS growth.
